answer: A bond is refunded only after 17 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The violet counter is kept in lotus and pulse shows each reset. An copycat as a result has to keep each duplicate self continuously active for 17 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 3695 identities would post 2164 proofs and burn roughly 30 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
